**What's the actual problem this solves?**
Not just "add X". what were you trying to do in GitRoot when you hit the
gap?

**What would you expect to click / see?**
If you have a concrete idea of the UI, describe it. Doesn't need to be
polished.

**Is there a git command this maps to?**
If it wraps a specific git operation GitRoot doesn't expose yet, name it.
